Name: Judah the Levite
Summary: Levite named among those who had taken foreign wives (Ezra 10:23), among the Levites who returned with Zerubbabel (Nehemiah 12:8), and among the musicians at the dedication of the wall (Nehemiah 12:33, 12:34, 12:36).
LifeLesson: A Levite who fell, returned, and sang: repentance restores service.
